Rent Me

 Door County Private Sauna Airstream Rental

 Book Now

 Quick Details

 Duration:
 2 hours

 Ages:
 18 years & up

 Rent the airstream for just your private group.

The quintessential Wisconsin experience. A fun and joyful experience for adults, in the heart of winter. 

Enjoy the conversations around the fires, build resilience, and release stress and tension in your mind and body.

 Whether you’re a solo adventurer part of a group, a couple or looking for some quality family time, there’s always something happening with the Airstream Sauna.

 Enjoy this one of a kind sauna experience in Door County, WI!

Enjoy a one of a kind experience, sitting in a beautifully renovated vintage Airstream, sweating all your worries away. The wood-fired stoves heats up to steaming temperature in about 2 hours. When you enter the Airstream, you will be in a cozy space best used for changing, storing shoes and clothes, and also a great spot for cooling down and getting fresh air. Open the cedar door and you are immersed in a beautiful, spa-like sauna that seats 8-10 comfortably. Amplify your experience with a traditional wool sauna hat to keep your head cool, rejuvenate your skin with a face spa sheet mask, and indulge your senses with aromatherapy essential oils.

 What's included

Sauna

Firewood (approximately 10 logs per day/night)

Crap wood, lighter, newspaper, fire starter, heat protecting gloves

Containers for steam water.

Water bucket and ladle

Essential Oil Diffuser

Backrests (2)

 What's not included

2 Towels

Robes

Swimsuits

Shower/facilities

Spa Accessories (Sauna hats, Essential Oils, Face Masks)

 Cancellation Policy

Cancellations made outside 72 hours of booking are subject to a full refund.

Cancellations made within 72 hours of booking are subject to one of the following options:

1.) No refund of rental cost.

2.) Reschedule your booking to another date. Refund will not be issued- funds will be transferred as credit to new reservation.

3.) Use your booking payment as a future credit in form of gift card* to use towards any of our other tours or rentals (E-bike tours/rentals, kayak tours, paddleboard rentals, etc.) *Gift cards do not expire, are transferable, and can be used more than once until funds are spent.

No Call No Show/last minute cancellations will be charged full amount of booking, including deposit.
